question: How powerful is ignorance in deluding beings, even divine ones?
premises: Ignorance is being questioned as a deluding force.
Even immortals are considered possible victims.
The Goddess is addressed as witness to this power.
inference: Ignorance is so powerful that it can delude even the immortals.
plain_english: O Lady of the gods, what then of ignorance—can it not delude even the immortals?
